tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Semantic search over the complete MarketCheck API documentation and API policies (2,000+ indexed sections). Returns the most relevant excerpts, each with its source page URL and endpoint. Use this first for any question about endpoints, parameters, authentication, errors, or terms. For plans and per-call prices, use get_plans_and_limits.

query.description: Natural-language question or keywords, e.g. 'filter active listings by dealer id'.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Fetch one full documentation page as Markdown, including resolved parameter tables and curl examples. Use a 'Page:' URL or path returned by search_docs or get_endpoint, e.g. '/docs/api/cars/inventory/inventory-search'. UK pages are under '/uk/docs/...'.

path.description: Docs path starting with /docs or /uk, or a full https://docs.marketcheck.com URL.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List every documented MarketCheck REST endpoint: method, path, one-line title, region, and docs URL (~73 endpoints across US/UK cars, dealers, VIN decode, history, valuations).

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match on path or title, e.g. 'dealer'.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Exact reference for one REST endpoint: every query parameter (name, type, description, required, default), a real sample request, and a truncated real sample response. Use the path as shown by list_endpoints, e.g. '/v2/search/car/active'.

path.description: Endpoint path, e.g. /v2/search/car/active. Full api.marketcheck.com URLs accepted.

method.description: Optional; defaults to the single documented method.

tools.name: get_plans_and_limits
tools.description: Current published MarketCheck rate plans: per-call pricing, monthly quotas, and rate limits for a region, sourced from the live plan list (authoritative over docs). NA prices in USD, UK in GBP.
